name: Shock
description: Black Crusade, Table 8-4 (p. 277). Rolled after a failed Fear Test in combat, adding +10 per Degree of Failure. A Heretic may modify the roll by his Infamy characteristic, to a minimum of 1. Mechanical effects only - read the full description from the rulebook.

results.name: Badly Startled
results.text: One Half Action only on the next turn, then act normally.

results.name: Shaking
results.text: -10 to all tests for the rest of the encounter unless the character Snaps Out of It.

results.name: Backing Away
results.text: Cannot willingly approach the source of Fear. -10 to all tests for the rest of the encounter.

results.name: Frozen in Terror
results.text: No Actions until the character Snaps Out of It, then -10 to all tests for the rest of the encounter.

results.name: Panic
results.text: Must flee the source of Fear. If prevented, Half Actions only and -20 to all tests. Once clear, must Snap Out of It to regain control.

results.name: Fainting
results.text: Unconscious for [[1d5]] rounds, then -10 to all tests for the rest of the encounter.

results.name: Retching
results.text: Drops everything held and can do nothing for [[1d5]] rounds. Afterwards one Half Action per turn until the character can rest.

results.name: Hysteria
results.text: Attacks anything nearby at random until the character Snaps Out of It or is knocked unconscious.

results.name: Collapse
results.text: Helpless and able to do nothing for [[1d5+1]] rounds, then -20 to all tests until the end of the encounter.

results.name: Catatonia
results.text: Catatonic for [[1d5]] hours and cannot be roused.

results.name: Heart Stops
results.text: Challenging (+0) Toughness Test. Success: catatonic for [[1d5]] hours and cannot be roused. Failure: the character dies.
